results.title: Multi-scale fusion semantic enhancement network for medical image ...
results.content: The H2Former model introduced by He et al.14.") employs a hierarchical hybrid architecture that combines the strengths of CNN’s local information, multi-scale channel attention features (MSRA), and the long-range dependencies of the transformer, significantly enhancing image segmentation accuracy. The feature images from both branches are then combined channel-wise for fusion, with a ReLU activation to combine global and local features.Finally, the Efficient Spatial Attention (ESA)36.") module is employed to refine the fused feature representation, strengthening the network’s attention to the target area while effectively suppressing background interference.The entire MSFE module combines multi-scale extraction, local detail enhancement, and attention optimization to enhance the model’s capacity to process intricate medical images more effectively. The PSE module utilizes a two-fold attention strategy to extract multi-scale global semantic features while also integrating local context information.MFSE-Net outperformed 10 SOTA methods on Re-TMRS datasets, both quantitatively and qualitatively, showcasing its superiority in renal tumor segmentation.
